meta.name: env-and-assets-bootstrap
meta.description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line_en: For you if a deep learning repo won't run and you're stuck on setup and paths

howto.what: 为 README 记录的深度学习仓库复现准备环境：给出保守的 conda 安装步骤、checkpoint 与数据集路径计划、缓存位置提示和搭建笔记，并列出未决的依赖或资源风险。
howto.when: 在仓库接受环节确认可信的复现目标之后、运行任何命令之前，需要创建环境或准备 checkpoint、数据集等资源路径时触发。

howto.what_en: Prepares a reproduction environment for README-documented deep learning repos: conservative conda steps, checkpoint and dataset path plans, cache hints, setup notes, and open dependency or asset risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers after repo intake confirms a credible reproduction target, before any run, when an environment or asset paths must be prepared.
